title: Electroactive phase dependent triboelectric nanogenerator performance of PVDF–TiO2 composites
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,683-698
DOI: 10.1039/D4YA00525B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Irthasa Aazem, Charchit Kumar, Ryan Walden, Aswathy Babu, Amit Goswami, Steven J. Hinder, Gaurav Khandelwal, Daniel M. Mulvihill, Gerard McGranaghan, Suresh C. Pillai
This investigation explores the impact of the electroactive phase of a well-known tribonegative polymer, polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF), on its triboelectric behaviour by compositing it with anatase, rutile, and mixed-phase TiO2 nanoparticles.
